title: Mixed Event — SEKAI Happy New Year!

meta.Outline: Celebrate the New Year with Miku and the others in SEKAI! Get ready for a special episodic story featuring all group members!

rows.Line: Between Worlds

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Happy New Year!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's great to see you so soon in the new year!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, let's make this year wonderful too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thanks for looking after everyone with me last year. You were so helpful!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thanks to you, I was also able to have an amazing year.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Would you be able to help me keep an eye on everyone this year too?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yay!
I was hoping you'd say that!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I hope this turns out to be another great year. For us here in SEKAI, for our friends from the real world, for everyone...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That includes you too, of course!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, would you like to go over to SEKAI together?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm really curious to see how everyone's celebrating the New Year.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Great!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Let's go check up on everyone!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<K, I tweaked that thing from earlier.

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Because it's cold. I don't want to leave my cozy house.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Same here...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Aww, seriously...?!
What about you, Yuki?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<Cram school for the holidays.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yikes, that's pretty rough to have classes while everyone else is on vacation...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <If you have nothing to do, Mizuki, why don't you just stay at home?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Didn't you say you're going to a gig or a show for New Year's Eve...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Oh, the anime song countdown event?
Unfortunately, I couldn't get tickets...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <It wasn't that popular last year but they got some famous singers lined up this year, so tickets sold out fast.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I got tickets the last two years, so I thought I was good to go but...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Then just stay home like I said. Don't get desperate and try to organize something on the fly.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I know but... My parents left for the holidays to visit my sis living overseas...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <So I have to cook my own dinner and stuff. It's too much of a bother, so I want to go out to eat.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Which is why I thought it'd be nice to go out with you guys...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Pity that's not going to happen...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Are you seriously going to refuse my invite? Don't you want to go hang out together?!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Nope.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Sorry, Mizuki...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Well, I tried...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<I'm logging off now.
See you later tonight.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(I guess everybody's already got plans.
But N25 seemed like my best bet...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sigh...

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:

<Yay!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Woohoo! Thanks, guys!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I'll let you know on Nightcord when everything's ready, and then we can move over to SEKAI.>

Sorry, Lion Dance Robot!
This is the end of our race!

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: CHOMP...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Neneee, now! Release the net!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Dropping the net on the robot...!

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: CHOMP CHOMP?!?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Bullseye! Len, hold down the edge of the net so it doesn't escape!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Roger!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Nice! They caught it with the net!

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: CHOMP CHOMP CHOMP!!!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
We're almost finished.
Nene, the rest is up to you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Lift it up, nice and steady.

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: RAAARGH! CHOMP CHOMP CHOMP!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Woooow, it's being airlifted!
Rui's drones are crazy strong!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's a big catch, huh?

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: CHOMP...!!!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Sorry, but it's time to turn you off.

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: CHOMP?! CH...OM... P...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Phew... I'm glad you're still in one piece, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thanks for helping me out there!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Welcome back, Tsukasa☆
You must be exhausted after all that running!!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I managed to collect some very interesting data too. Now, I just have to analyze it when I get home.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, how about showing me some more sympathy? I had an awful time because of your robot, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, we get it. You had a rough time. Can we get back to making mochi already...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, let's do it! I brought soy sauce, sweet soybean powder and matcha, so we can make a bunch of different flavors☆

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, Emu! Can I have a turn with the mallet?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Sure! I'll show you how to do it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I feel like they're treating me worse and worse as time passes...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What a rough way to start the new year, Tsukasa. I'm glad you're okay.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It really is and I'm glad SOMEONE acknowledges that.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, well...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: At least you never get bored in this company?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, that's true!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Boredom doesn't suit a future star like myself!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. There's our usual Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Shall we join the others and make some mochi?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right. I'll make mochi with a real bite to it and show off my star power!
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay, that was pretty good.
Let's call it a day.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yay!
Shiho approved of our performance!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You just barely passed by my standards.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But it's late, so we can leave it for now and iron things out next time.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. You're such a perfectionist.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
But it was a good session.
Well done, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thanks.
You were a big help too, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I hope you'll join us next time and... Wait...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Is this our last practice for the year?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You're right. Tomorrow's New Year's Eve...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Then you should all take some time off and enjoy the holidays.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm all for that! Breaks are important too after all!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So let's wrap things up here and go to a cafe or the mall...♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
The forecast said it would snow.
We should go home soon.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, and it's supposed to get really cold tonight too...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
And stores keep different hours this time of year.
I doubt we'd be able to stay for long.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah... Right...
But I really wanted to hang out...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, in that case...
How about a sleepover at my house...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
A sleepover?
YEAH!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
But it's New Year's Eve tomorrow.
Won't we be bothering your parents...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That's okay.
They left to go to a hot spring resort yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Plus, I think they'll be happier knowing that I'm not all alone at home.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yay! Ichi, you're the best!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hona, Shiho, you're coming too, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. I'm not scheduled to work either, so I'll just need to tell my parents where I'm going.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Same. I'm on break too so I can come.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Awesome! We're gonna have an amazing New Year's Eve♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You're so fired up, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you worked things out.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah. It'll be another opportunity for you to make some great memories together.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Why don't we have a sleepover too, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm sure it'd be fun, but I'm afraid that it'll just turn into a guitar-training session...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, since we're having a sleepover, how about we all visit a shrine together to celebrate the new year?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, that'd be nice!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess we could do that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yay! This is gonna be awesome!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Miku, Luka...
Would like to come with us too?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, us?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, if you're interested that is...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Thanks! We'd love to come!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Me too. You only get to do this once a year so...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
But how do you plan on going?
SEKAI doesn't have any temples or shrines...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe♪ You'll see.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
This is getting exciting♪
I can't wait to get started!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Saki. You're so impatient.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Miku, Luka. We'll call you just before the date changes, okay?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Okay! We'll be looking forward to it!
New Year's Eve
Ichika's Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's been ages since I've been in your room, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
It's just as I remembered.
Oh, you still have lots of Miku's CDs.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. I saved up to buy them, so they're pretty special to me.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, I'll get us all something to drink.
I'll be right back.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Let me help! I'd feel bad if we made you do everything by yourself...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then... Shiho and I will get the cards and stuff ready!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Wait, what? Cards?
This is the first time I'm hearing about this.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But it's like THE thing you do during sleepovers! Come on, Shiho, help me get things ready!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, okay. I'll help...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. Looks like they're having fun too.
Thanks for inviting us over, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No problem. I'm happy you could all come.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Nooo! How did I lose again?
You're too good at Sevens, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Haha. I just got lucky.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I was so close to winning too...
I shouldn't have waited with that 9.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, it's almost midnight...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It is! Time really flies by when we're together.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
We should call Miku and Luka...
Huh? Did my phone just flash?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, mine too...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hello, girls! How's your sleepover going?>
bgm_area00001

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Luka! You came to join us!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I just couldn't wait!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <You should've seen her. She was so fidgety...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh? Is the pot calling the kettle black?>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, now that we're all here, let's get ready to go!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's great that we get to celebrate New Year's together like this.
Shrine Hall

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, there. The date just changed.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Happy New Year, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Happy New Year!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: All the best for the new year, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah. Let's have a good year.
But wow... Look at this crowd.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, it might be a while until we get our turn at the shrine.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But that gives us more time to think about our New Year's wishes♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <What are you going to wish for, Luka?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. That's a secret!>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hmm, what should I wish for...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Maybe to get better at playing guitar?
Hmm, or...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
The line's moving pretty fast.
It'll be our turn soon.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Let's get our coins ready!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Look, I brought loads of 5-yen coins!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
But you're supposed to throw in only one.
You didn't have to bring so many...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Everyone's having a good time.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (This time last year I wouldn't have imagined we'd all be here like this. I'm happy things worked out...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Oh, I think I know what to wish for now...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Okay, we can check that off!
Now, let's take a look around!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki, that's really all you've been thinking about since practice...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But it's the best part of doing this♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hey, look!
There are so many stalls!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wow. They're selling cotton candy, chocolate-dipped bananas and... It's like a festival.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ichi, see that yakisoba stall over there?
Wanna go get some?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sure. Let's buy enough for everyone.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, thanks.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Just looking at all these different stalls is a lot of fun.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yeah. Everything looks delicious!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We can buy some stuff here and bring it over to SEKAI later if you'd like.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Really, you'd do that for us?>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Everything's boxed up, so it's easy to carry around. And I'd feel bad if you just watched us eat and not be able to join in...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Thanks, Shiho. You're so kind!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Miku, Luka, look...!
There's a fortune box for omikuji over there.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Oh, I see the sign.
It says for good luck.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Do you want to try it?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I'd like to, but I'm not sure how we can...>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I can get one for you if you'd like.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, you'd do that for me? Thanks!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I guess I'll draw one for fun too.
How about you, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I don't know... I wouldn't like it if I got a great blessing and used up all of my luck for the year...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. You're assuming that you'll get the best fortune there is?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Don't worry. Even if you do, it doesn't mean your luck will run out or anything.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Well, in that case...
Shiho, could you draw one for me?>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, no problem.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, I'm going to draw one for Luka first!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Let's see. It says...
Great... C-C-Curse?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh dear...>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I've never seen one of those before...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I-I'm so sorry, Luka...! I've doomed you to bad fortune for the entire year...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Don't worry about it, Honami. Drawing fortunes is just a fun custom. You haven't spoiled Luka's luck or anything.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Exactly. Besides, this fortune says, if you work hard, you'll be rewarded, so it's not all doom and gloom.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I'll just carry on as always by working on my music, and everything will be just fine.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Luka...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, I still feel really bad about it!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh?>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We can count this one as mine, so let's draw another one!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: This one says... Curse?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honami...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
There you are!
Shiho! Hona!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hm? What's up?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: There was free amazake, so I got you some too! It's really good!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, thanks. I'm not into sweet drinks.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What? But it's sooo good!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Wait, what happened to you, Honami?
You look like the world just ended...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Sob...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That was an awesome shrine visit!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yeah, it was.
Well, most of it...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You don't have to get so hung up on those fortunes, Honami...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: By the way, what did you all wish for?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, you mean when we prayed at the shrine?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! I was wondering what you all wished for...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: My wish was just for us to have another fun year together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi, that's exactly what I wished for too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But mine wasn't just for this year...
It was for forever and ever!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. My wish was something like that too.
How about you, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Same...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That's amazing!
We all made the same wish!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe. Looks like your feelings for each other haven't changed since you found your song.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <They really haven't.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, look at the time. Should we head back?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, let's go.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I hope we can do this again next year...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're already thinking of what we're going to do next year?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
There's nothing wrong with that!
I wanna do this again next year too!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay. Then let's promise to do this again next year!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <You look happy, Miku.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Because I am!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <It makes me happy to see them all planning things for the future like this after being apart for so long.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Right. They might go through some rough patches this year too...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <But I'm looking forward to seeing how things go for them, so let's keep on supporting them.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yeah!>
